title: CN opponent-Active printed owned-attack selection, pure pre-commit plan
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 SHA256 27bda43d8cb78ed800891c6793e5efd945ac64d94a83ceff8adaed10e8f67419: II.C-15 PDF p36; II.C-17 p38, II.D-04 p43 and II.D-06 p44–45 contain the printed owned-attack selection example; II.E-37 p74–75 excludes extra attacks provided by Tools, Abilities or permission to use lower evolution cards (one-based). This is a bounded software window/plan protocol, NOT card approval or authorization. Only the current opponent Active top card's printed mechanics.attacks are candidates, regardless of Energy, current legality, quotas or existing locks. Protection is host-supplied; it never changes candidate membership or the exact-one choice requirement. Pure plans do not emit effects, determine same-name/cross-source identity matching, create ongoing ledgers, calculate expiry, move cards, read hidden/effective/extra-attack state or sample RNG.

window.description: Candidates retain printed order; each instanceId equals target.topCardId and attackId is unique. The pure window enforces these context relations. A present Pokemon may have no printed attacks. This schema is not a complete game-state/catalog validator.

plan.description: Detached selected refs, not an effect/ongoing ledger or permission token. A nonempty original candidate window requires exactly one original ref even if blocked; no candidates require none. A blocked choice remains selected with performed false. Context membership and the authoritative host mask are enforced by the pure plan, not schema alone.
